## Getting started
When contributing, please follow these key principles:
- **Clarity and simplicity**: The goal of this project is {readable by future contributors}.
- **Meaning over grammar**: Grammatical correctness is important, but not as important as clarity and meaning.
- **Inclusive language**: Use inclusive language by keeping this project's users as widespread as possible.
- **Accessible technical language**: Jargon is sometimes necessary, but supports every contributor regardless of technical expertise.
- **Clear terminology**: Use the established technical abbreviations that exist in this project.
## Issues
- Search [existing issues](/issues) before creating new ones
- Use our *label reference* to categorize appropriately
- Follow the Issue templates provided in this project
- Commit the contribution using best practices
## Pull Requests
- Follow the Pull Request template provided in this project
- Link the Pull Request to an Issue if applicable

A team member will review following our *standard review* process.
## Your PR is merged!
Congratulations! The {repo-name} team thanks you for your contribution!<br>
